label: Settings Page
description: A sectioned settings form that knows what you have changed. Profile, Notifications and Appearance sections built from labelled text, dropdown and checkbox fields in the same style as Form Fields, plus a save bar that is not there at all until a field actually differs from the value it loaded with — then it names the count ("2 unsaved changes") and offers Save and Discard. Discard puts every field back; Save re-baselines, so the values you just saved become the new "unchanged". Out of the box it loads a realistic sample record from a Static Data node; connect your own object to Settings and it wins. Publishes Values, Is Dirty and Change Count, and fires Saved / Discarded.
